scope: Commercial redistribution of the root ob.js connector in the Arenzyra Windows desktop launcher

repositoryReview.historyScope: Available local Git history only; no upstream authorship or license provenance was established.
repositoryReview.reviewMethod: The exact connector bytes, current file header, and available local revisions were inspected. This technical repository review is not a commercial-rights approval.

commercialReleaseApproval.notes: The exact connector is a required launcher resource, but the repository does not contain reviewed evidence authorizing its commercial redistribution.

evidenceRequirements.verificationNote: A future approval must be bound to these exact connector bytes. The verifier must receive each reviewed evidence document as out-of-band bytes and match documentSha256; approval metadata in this file is insufficient by itself.
